title: Azure Court Method of the Great Engine
summary: Teaches court crews to raise and throw the heaviest shot of the great trebuchet with the qi of the whole crew.

title: Twin Beam Canon of Linked Throws
summary: Teaches two engines tied by a signal cord so their crews wind release and strike a single point together.

title: River Line Doctrine of the Iron Fall
summary: Teaches throwing iron shot at river craft and fords by reading the current and leading the target.

title: Hawk Court Treatise on the Unseen Stone
summary: Teaches the hawk court art of loosing a trebuchet unseen and unheard so the first warning is the falling stone.

title: Basin Book of the Siege Train
summary: Teaches the marching assembly and opening salvo of a whole train of trebuchets brought by road to a besieged place.

title: Dual-Track Manual of the Counter Battery
summary: Teaches two tracks of spotters and engines that find an enemy trebuchet by its fall and answer it at once.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Plateau Engine
summary: Teaches oath-bound crews to bed guy and fire a trebuchet on the open plateau rock through every shift of the wind.

title: Oath Book of the Bearing Held Battery
summary: Teaches a battery bound by one oath chain to hold a single bearing and loose in turn as one voice.

title: Treatise on Engines with Nothing to Hide Behind
summary: Teaches how engines on open ground spread out strike fast and fall back when the enemy closes in.

title: Gale Reckoning of the Far Throw
summary: Teaches reckoning distance and wind drift so a lengthened arm can strike a mark far beyond the plateau.

title: Plateau Edge Doctrine of the Oath Sling
summary: Teaches the knotted oath sling and its release at the plateau edge so the stone leaves true in any gale.

title: Book of Counter-Throws in the Gale
summary: Teaches reading an enemy stone through the gale and answering it along the wind before the crew has settled.
